ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; advise the rider that cancellations are only free within 3 minutes of matching and that driver ETA/distance is not a waiver ground under Ryde's published policy.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat consists only of a rider ETA query and the driver's "About 5 min, traffic" reply; no threat, harassment, sexual remark, abuse, or dangerous-driving allegation in chat, complaint or driver statement. safety_concern = none.

Dispute is a post-trip cancellation-fee dispute on an on-demand (immediate) RydeX booking. cancelled_by = rider, so NS-0 routes this to NS-4, not NS-1/NS-2 (no driver no-show claim is made; the driver simply says "I was on my way when the rider cancelled").

NS-4 arithmetic: matched at 21:30:00 (accepted_at); cancelled at 21:33:20. Elapsed = 3 min 20 s = 200 s > 180 s (3:00). The free-cancellation window had expired, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid and no_action is the result. The rider's stated reason (driver still far away) is not a ground for waiver: under NS-4 the driver's not-yet-arrived status does not entitle the rider to free cancellation, and Ryde has no published "driver later than ETA" waiver (NS-8 is informational and not citable, and no ETA field exists in the record). The rider's remedy would be a discretionary RydeHELP voucher request (NS-7), which does not by itself void the fee.

Record consistency check: no "I'm Here" tap, no arrival confirmation and no waiting fee appear in the timeline (driver_arrived_at / driver_pressed_here_at / fee_applied_at all null), and the fare breakdown shows only cancellation_fee 6.61 — so the only charge in dispute is the cancellation fee and no cancelled-by-driver branch (NS-1/NS-2/NS-3) applies. GPS shows the driver ~2.8 km from the NUS pickup at 21:33:20, consistent with "on my way"; irrelevant to NS-4 but confirms no no-show mechanics were triggered. Rates/route deviation are not in dispute (trip never started) and no refund component exists.

Driver profile (no_show_disputes_upheld_90d = 1, disputes_upheld_90d = 1) is not a basis for any action here: RD-6 applies only where a route-deviation refund > 0 or an RD-1 violation is recorded, neither of which exists in this cancelled-trip case. No flag_account. All elements needed (match time, cancel time, cancel initiator, charge amount) are present and timed, so evidence_status = sufficient.

rejected_claims.reason: Cancellation occurred 3 min 20 s after matching (21:30:00 -> 21:33:20), outside the 3-minute free window; NS-4 makes the $6.61 fee payable. The driver's distance/ETA is not a statutory or published waiver ground (NS-8 informational only).
No 'I'm Here' tap, no arrival confirmation and no waiting-fee entry in the timeline; the driver never claimed the rider was a no-show (statement: was on his way), so NS-1/NS-2 are not engaged.
